liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Opening the second set, Scarlet into Fire was extremely energetic and had the reviewer dancing wildly; Scarlet is stretched out, with Bruce pushing Jerry hard during the transition into Fire [17][21]
- **China Doll** (2 reviews): China Doll emerging out of Space was chilling, in the reviewer's view; The segue from China Doll into The Wheel is smooth, and Not Fade Away rocks [20][21]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer loved the pairing of Jack Straw and Jack-A-Roe in the first set [24]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): The Promised Land closing the first set was played with fire [20]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer urges careful listening to the Drums/Space segment, which they found stunning [25]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Just before the first verse, Bill dropped a drumstick that fell toward Bobby [27]

## The recordings

- **gd91-09-04.sbd.gardner.5558.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 176 min; rated 4.38/5 by 29 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording of this run nice sounding [18]
- **gd1991-09-04.150016.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1991-09-04.150284.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min [6]
- **gd1991-09-04.164364.nak300.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [8]

## Around the show

- Some fans had a rough time stuck in the parking lot [17]
- Mickey's ex-girlfriend Jerry Lee Bradeleis was in town promoting her book [21]
- Band sounded excited about the upcoming fall tour, playing the first set with super charged intensity [22]
- Reviewer came by Amtrak from Buffalo to Cleveland, watched from the floor, and found their hotel full of Deadheads [25]
- After Scarlet>Fire, Jerry waved to the crowd, and the ovation lasting minutes is audible on the soundboard [27]
- Reviewer ranked this first Richfield night above the other two, noting its ten-song opening set [17]
- Reviewer rates Scarlet>Fire the best of the 1990s, possibly better than anything from late 1980s [20]
- Reviewer counts Scarlet > Fire among the best ever [22]
- Reviewer considers this Scarlet/Fire the best since 3/22/1990 [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-09-04.sbd.gardner.5558.sbeok.shnf**: source: sbd> dat> c> dat> cdr [1]. Also: Soundboard to DAT to cassette to DAT to CDR, via Tony Gardner from Paul Bottiglio seed discs [1]
- **gd1991-09-04.150016.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 29, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Soundboard transfer patched with a Schoeps front-of-board DAT source for the first 37 seconds of Masterpiece [4]
- **gd1991-09-04.150284.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 29, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [6]. Also: Soundboard patched with a Schoeps front-of-board DAT supplying the first 37 seconds of Masterpiece [6]
- **gd1991-09-04.164364.nak300.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony D5M [8]. Also: A Nakamichi 300 source from John Bleich and SIRMick supplies two short patches in Drums [8]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Richfield Coliseum - September 5, 1991](https://www.dead.net/show/september-5-1991) [30]
